contact.basis: Fixed original southmost outer worshiphall vertex6m outboard into public approach before terrain/geometry; true threshold/approach grade not surveyed.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Atsuta Hongu sanctuary and south worshiphall approach frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.3m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact building approach/urban grade classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
